title: Project schedule with precedence, overtime, and penalty threshold
text: A project has tasks A, B, C, D with durations dA=8, dB=6, dC=10, dD=12. Task B and C start after A; D starts after both B and C. You can pay overtime to reduce any single task by up to 21% at cost 55 per hour reduced. If total completion time exceeds 34, you pay penalty 76 per hour late, but if you finish at or before 32 you receive bonus 1187. Find the minimum expected cost assuming overtime decisions are made after you learn that task C’s duration is actually dC+3 (with probability 0.578) otherwise dC.
